about_the_game:
Escape the stress of real life and step into a peaceful farming world. In this idle sticker game, you can relax and build your own cozy farm while going about your daily routine. While you’re working or taking a break, your virtual land continues to grow and evolve in the background. Made for people who are busy or task-saturated but still want a fun escape.

Even when you’re not actively playing — maybe you’re “working” with 20 tabs open or in the middle of a meeting — the game keeps going in the background. It’s designed to match your rhythm: always moving, always mellow, and waiting for your return. When you do come back, your clicks and actions give everything a little boost, helping your tiny world grow even faster. You start with a small farm. From there, you unlock cute characters, collect new resources, and discover different lands. These lands are actually ancient giant beings who let you stay on them like friendly, magical hosts. Each one has a different theme and story, like a new little world to explore.

In this demo, you’ll start with a small, floofy farm and experience the core gameplay loop — all wrapped in a world built from hand-crafted visuals, animations, and interactions designed to soothe and amuse.

  • Plant your first crops and start your farm from scratch

  • Unlock a few cute characters who help automate and decorate your space

  • Collect basic resources like seeds and branches

  • Leave the game running while you work, and return to see your progress

  • Click and interact to speed things up and feel like a true multitasking magician

  • Settle on your very first ancient host creature, who serves as the cozy backdrop to your farming zone

  • Discover and personalize new lands at your own pace

  • Interactive elements that create a sense of a living, breathing world

This demo is about how the game flows, how progress feels, and how the AFK-friendly system works while you do other things. It’s like a tiny vacation on your desktop. No deadlines, no pressure — just a little loop of calm and productivity that plays along with your day. And it features:

  • A small selection of starter crops, resources, and floofy characters

  • 1 themed “host” land (an ancient creature that houses your farm)

  • AFK/idle system

  • Boost system that activates when you return from being away

  • Basic interactions: click to collect, unlock, and progress

  • Playtime: about 30-60 minutes of active play, with additional passive progression

Notes

This demo includes only early-game content. Some characters, systems, lands, and features you might encounter in trailers or screenshots may be part of the full game. Your progress will not carry over. This game is like a quiet dream for multitasking workers — a break from emails and stress, and a slow, happy journey and it helps you be concentrated into a world full of floof, fun, farming, and lovingly crafted details.
